scope: Two clock views of the same retained run; longest RAF-timestamp and Page-observation gaps can have different endpoints. No scheduler wait is inferred by subtracting C++ costs.

peers.sampleClock: Page performance.now sampled after audio observation and play.frame, before updateInput/metrics/onFrame records; not physical scanout or an externally calibrated clock.
